text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—Month ●, Day X. Clear skies.
Today, I will definitely find a clue.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Looks like I won the bet. As promised, let me collect that tandem run data.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Proposing a deal to collect data...
"Forceful methods are sometimes necessary," noted.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: *Puff*, *pant*... Shakur-san knows so many shortcuts...! "Turning even non-paths into paths," noted...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Tch.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Ah...! Oh no, I'm going to lose sight of her—!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Oh? Shakur-san, where did you go...?

text_block_list.name: Loitering Man
text_block_list.text: What're you lookin' around for... This ain't a place for brats!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Kh?! U-Um...

text_block_list.name: Tattooed Man
text_block_list.text: Kyahaha! This here's our turf. Scram before you get hurt!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...I, I will not leave.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I have things I must accomplish. I cannot simply turn back!

text_block_list.name: Loitering Man
text_block_list.text: Haaah? Hey, don't you get you're not in a spot to be throwin' tantrums? Guess you're askin' for it...!
If you lay a hand on her, you're the ones in deep shit. Hand her over.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Sit in that chair. If you're in the back of this shop, those guys won't follow.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: U-Um, Shakur-san... Thank you so much for saving—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What's your deal? You've been following me around relentlessly lately...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ! ...I apologize. I am truly sorry for that.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...I wanted to change. From who I am right now.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Even when I change my training, it doesn't show in my results... I haven't been able to break out of my shell...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I thought that perhaps... my tendency to get stuck in rigid molds might be the cause...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...That's why I felt I needed to be bold. Like your way of being, Shakur-san—unbound by conventional molds!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Please allow me to learn from you! In order to break out of my shell... and change my destiny...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: *Haa*... *haa*... Dammit, I'm still lacking speed... by exactly "7 cm".

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Parcae. What else am I missing? ...What do I have to do to change destiny...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: So... I will study diligently! After that, I promise I'll head back properly...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...What do you expect to gain from a place where I just hang around killing time?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Hah, hoooooo! Wow, that feels so refreshing...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Tch. Why me, of all people?
From that day on, I often saw Air Messiah chasing after Air Shakur. I couldn't help but wonder about this mismatched pair.
